Count the minutes of a shift

A care home keeps its staff's shifts in a timesheet: a start and an end time on a day. Some staff work night shifts, from the evening to the next morning.

## What to build

- [ ] `shiftMinutes(start, end)` in `src/timesheet.mjs` returns how many minutes a shift from `start` to `end` lasts, both times as `HH:MM`
- [ ] `dayMinutes(shifts)` returns the minutes of a day's shifts together, each shift a `{ start, end }`
- [ ] a test of both
